snippet.title: Inherited Shadows - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Amanda, a young woman haunted by her mother's absence, travels to the remote mining town of Cinder Hollow in search of answers, unaware that a sinister legacy awaits her. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mysteries surrounding her past.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939450/Inherited_Shadows/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
